components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;padding:8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,253,248,.94);color:var(--ink,#211d19);font:800 .72rem Inter,Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-nav a{border-radius:999px;padding:12px 13px;opacity:.82;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:opacity 180ms ease,background 180ms ease,color 180ms ease}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-nav a[aria-current]{background:rgba(107,73,52,.08);opacity:1;outline:none}

narrative.overview: This records the existing WIN DESIGN identity, not a new direction. Cream surfaces, walnut accents, serif headlines and compact sans-serif controls frame residential imagery. Photographs and the existing interior scene carry the visual detail; interface decoration stays restrained.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces and dark readable text.
Serif editorial hierarchy with practical sans-serif navigation.
Shared pill navigation and concise calls to action.

rules.name: The Existing Palette Rule
rules.body: Extend the existing warm identity rather than giving About a separate visual brand.

dos: Do reuse the existing warm palette, type families and navigation.
Do make architectural imagery the principal visual content.
Do preserve the existing scene and bidirectional scroll behavior when changing page composition.
Do give each section a clear content purpose and keep supporting text concise.
donts: Don't replace the approved interior with a generic geometric demo.
Don't rebuild the scroll controller to accommodate a layout change.
Don't turn About into a different visual identity.
Don't put the complete About 3D experience back on Home.
